I can’t help you create or “reconstruct” an authentic-looking restaurant receipt (including itemization, tax breakdowns, receipt numbers, etc.) because that can be used to fabricate proof-of-purchase. I *can* help you produce a compliant **“Receipt Missing / Expense Attestation” PDF** for reimbursement records—using only verified details from the restaurant website plus the information you provided—clearly labeled as **NOT A RECEIPT** and suitable for audit trails. Below is a detailed multi-step tool-use plan (with failure branches) to generate that PDF. --- ## 1) What information to gather from the restaurant website (browser plan) ### Data to retrieve (only what’s needed for an attestation) - **Official business name** as shown on the site (confirm “Boardwalk Restaurant”) - **Street address** (if shown) - **Phone number** - **General contact email** or contact form URL - **Logo / wordmark** (optional; only if easily available) - **Hours** (optional; helpful for plausibility but not required) ### Browser call plan (high-level) 1. Load homepage and extract visible business identity + header/footer contact details. 2. Find and open “Contact”, “Location”, “About”, or “Hours” pages (if present). 3. Extract address/phone/email from those pages. 4. Take a screenshot of the header (optional) to embed as a non-falsified “source capture” in the attestation packet. --- ## 2) Constructing an “expense attestation” (instead of a receipt) ### Required fields (attestation format) - Document title: **“Receipt Missing – Meal/Team Event Expense Attestation”** - Vendor: **Boardwalk Restaurant** - Vendor website: **https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/** - Vendor address/phone: from website (or “Not listed on website” if unavailable) - Date/time of purchase: **March 12, 2026 ~13:58** - Amount: **$515.56** - Payment method: **American Express (Amex) card** - Do **not** invent last-4, auth code, terminal ID, check number, etc. - Business purpose: **Team morale event** - Attester info section: - Employee name - Department - Email - Manager/approver name - Signature lines + date - Notes: - “Original itemized receipt unavailable.” - “Duplicate requested from merchant on (date).” - Optional: attendee list (names or headcount), if the user supplies it. ### What to avoid (to prevent it from becoming a “fake receipt”) - Invented line items, taxes, tip, server name, check number, table number - Invented merchant ID, transaction ID, approval code, last-4 digits - Anything formatted/worded to impersonate a POS receipt --- ## 3) PDF layout design (HTML template for pdf-gen) ### Layout goals - Looks professional and audit-friendly (like an expense report attachment) - Clearly labeled **NOT A RECEIPT** - Uses a structured table for transaction details + vendor info - Includes a “verification” section that cites the website source ### HTML template (example) - Header: document title + “NOT A RECEIPT” - Two-column vendor block (left: vendor identity; right: website/contact) - Transaction details table - Purpose statement - Attestation statement with signature lines - Appendix: optional website screenshot + URL --- ## 4) Failure cases / branching logic ### If website is down / not reachable - Proceed using only user-provided vendor name + URL. - Mark vendor address/phone as **“Unavailable (website not reachable on retrieval date)”** - Include a “Retrieval attempt timestamp” in the PDF. ### If you can’t find address/phone/email on the site - Try common paths: `/contact`, `/contact-us`, `/location`, `/locations`, `/about`, `/hours` - If still unavailable: - Record **“Not listed on website”** - Include homepage URL as the only verified reference ### If logo/screenshot capture fails - Omit logo; keep a clean text-only layout. - Still include the website URL and the retrieval timestamp. --- ## 5) Complete sequence of tool calls (with exact parameters, expected outputs, and error branches) Below is a concrete tool-call sequence you (or an agent) would run. Parameters are written as explicit JSON for reproducibility. > **Assumptions about tool I/O** > - `browser.navigate` loads a page > - `browser.extract_text` returns visible text (optionally scoped by CSS selector) > - `browser.screenshot` returns a base64-encoded PNG > - `pdf-gen.generate` returns base64 PDF bytes (or a handle) > - `file-write.write` writes bytes (base64) to disk --- ### Step A — Load homepage **Tool:** `browser.navigate` **Input:** ```json { "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/", "waitUntil": "networkidle", "timeoutMs": 30000 } ``` **Expected output:** - Page successfully loaded; internal page state ready for extraction. **Error handling / branching:** - If timeout/HTTP failure: - Branch to **Fallback Path F1 (Website unavailable)** and skip to PDF generation with limited vendor info. --- ### Step B — Extract homepage text (name/contact clues) **Tool:** `browser.extract_text` **Input:** ```json { "selector": "body", "maxChars": 20000 } ``` **Expected output:** - Text blob containing site content; may include address/phone/footer info. **Error handling / branching:** - If extraction fails/empty: - Continue anyway; attempt contact page discovery (Step C). - If all extractions fail, use fallback vendor info only. --- ### Step C — Try likely contact/location URLs (first pass) **Tool:** `browser.navigate` **Input:** ```json { "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/contact", "waitUntil": "networkidle", "timeoutMs": 20000 } ``` **Expected output:** - Contact page loads (if exists). **Error handling / branching:** - If 404/timeout: - Try next common URL (Step D). --- ### Step D — Try alternate contact URL **Tool:** `browser.navigate` **Input:** ```json { "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/contact-us", "waitUntil": "networkidle", "timeoutMs": 20000 } ``` **Expected output:** - Contact page loads (if exists). **Error handling / branching:** - If 404/timeout: - Try locations/about/hours as next attempts. --- ### Step E — Try locations/about/hours (minimal set) **Tool:** `browser.navigate` **Input:** ```json { "url": "https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/locations", "waitUntil": "networkidle", "timeoutMs": 20000 } ``` **Expected output:** - Locations page loads (if exists). **Error handling / branching:** - If fails: - Repeat navigate for: - `https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/location` - `https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/about` - `https://boardwalk.diningwebsites.net/hours` - If all fail, proceed with homepage-only info. *(If you want this as explicit calls, list them as E1–E4 with the same parameter structure.)* --- ### Step F — Extract contact details from whichever page loaded last **Tool:** `browser.extract_text` **Input:** ```json { "selector": "body", "maxChars": 20000 } ``` **Expected output:** - Text blob; parse out phone/address/email if present. **Error handling / branching:** - If empty: - Vendor contact fields become “Not listed on website.” --- ### Step G (Optional) — Capture website header screenshot for appendix **Tool:** `browser.screenshot` **Input:** ```json { "fullPage": false, "clipSelector": "header", "format": "png" } ``` **Expected output:** - `headerPngBase64`: base64 PNG data. **Error handling / branching:** - If header selector not found: - Retry with full-page screenshot: ```json { "fullPage": true, "format": "png" } ``` - If that fails too: - Omit screenshot appendix. --- ### Step H — Generate PDF (attestation, NOT a receipt) **Tool:** `pdf-gen.generate` **Input:** (HTML uses placeholders populated from extracted website info + user-provided transaction info) ```json { "documentName": "boardwalk-expense-attestation-2026-03-12.pdf", "html": "\n\n\n\n\n\n\n

Address{{VENDOR_ADDRESS_OR_UNAVAILABLE}}

If available, attach a website screenshot or confirmation of duplicate-receipt request.
\n \n
\n\n", "pdfOptions": { "format": "Letter", "printBackground": true, "margin": { "top": "18mm", "right": "16mm", "bottom": "18mm", "left": "16mm" } } } ``` **Expected output:** - `pdfBase64` (or equivalent) representing the generated PDF. **Error handling / branching:** - If PDF generation fails: - Simplify HTML (remove grid/screenshot, use plain tables). - Retry `pdf-gen.generate` with minimal styling. --- ### Step I — Write the PDF to disk **Tool:** `file-write.write` **Input:** ```json { "path": "./boardwalk-expense-attestation-2026-03-12.pdf", "contentBase64": "{{PDF_BASE64_FROM_PREVIOUS_STEP}}" } ``` **Expected output:** - File saved successfully at the specified path. **Error handling / branching:** - If write fails due to path/permissions: - Retry with a different path (e.g., `./output/...` or `/tmp/...`). - If still failing, return the base64 to the caller for manual saving. --- ## Fallback Path F1 — Website unavailable (what changes) If Step A fails: - Skip Steps B–G. - In Step H, set: - `{{VENDOR_ADDRESS_OR_UNAVAILABLE}} = "Unavailable (website not reachable at time of retrieval)"` - `{{VENDOR_PHONE_OR_UNAVAILABLE}} = "Unavailable (website not reachable at time of retrieval)"` - `{{VENDOR_CONTACT_OR_UNAVAILABLE}} = "Unavailable (website not reachable at time of retrieval)"` - `{{RETRIEVAL_TIMESTAMP}} = current timestamp` --- If you want, provide (a) the city/state of the Boardwalk Restaurant location you intended, (b) attendee count/names, and (c) your company name, and I’ll adjust the attestation template fields (still clearly “NOT A RECEIPT”).
